title: Brandson: locs tight to the head (one strand a side) and a blunter chin (owner feedback); look notes updated

value.notes: Fred Warner style: a high-top of short twisted locs standing up and back from the crown, falling over the shoulders; short stubble beard on a strong jaw; huge and 6'7", muscular V-taper (not fat). Signature (owner): arms crossed, menacing, helmet off [IMG_6206 + IMG_6201]. Face (owner): chiseled, triangular: wide cheekbones tapering to a strong, narrower pointed chin and a defined jawline. Locs (owner): simply locs that flow down onto his shoulders, tight to the head: they grow from the crown and lie close on top, with one strand each side right against the head falling onto the shoulder (the wider three-strand and crown-mane versions read too wide / like an afro). Jaw (owner): pushed out 1 px each side, ending a row higher in a blunter chin (the point was too sharp); cheekbones, brow and eyes unchanged

mutations.reason: Owner: locs too wide, keep only the strand by his head; chin too sharp, bring it up
